I’ll work on both in parallel. The companion-manuscript revision is already active in another chat, so I’ll keep this work in the research notes and ledgers.

The existing compact theorem supplies the field estimates needed near the switch at \(t=64\). I’m now deriving how amplitude changes move the comparison center, with enough control to compare that displacement against the much narrower rounding width.

The center calculation gives a useful result: all the named one-arm centers move by less than the rounding width. The uncorrected elementary center moves slightly later; the corrected centers move earlier. This preserves the existing switching law but does not sharpen its density error. The negative-time extension also looks viable; it is undergoing a separate check of the tail and evaluation costs.

Both bounded tasks have passed the internal analytical checks. The negative-time estimate extends to \(1/L\le T\le2\) with the same \(e^{-L^2/4}\) error target at a stated sufficient height. Its evaluation cost increases: the retained quadrature construction needs \(O(L^3)\) outer nodes. I’m recording that cost and the remaining limits in the progress files.

The initial check found a gap in the direct reuse of the signed-window proof: Gaussian shifts grow like \(tL\), so its fixed-strip remainder bound alone does not cover the full band. I’m testing a way around it: use that bound on a fixed inner strip, then group the outer shifted remainder as an ordinary Dirichlet tail. This may keep the existing finite-mode formula.

The new remainder estimate supports the existing frozen-\(N\) formula, with all \(N\asymp\sqrt X\) modes and the explicit Riemann–Siegel completion retained. The resulting allowance is \(\eta(X)=\Lambda^2X^{-3/4}\), and both overlaps appear to close. I’m giving the written proof a final internal check and preparing the whole-chat handoff.

The final internal checks found no unpaid estimate in AN03. **AN03 closes: no requested estimate remains unpaid.** The retained-arithmetic model satisfies, uniformly on \(4/L\le t\le1\),
\[
|\partial_z^j(H-F_N)|\le C_jE_o\Lambda^j\eta,\qquad
|(H-F_N)_t|\le CE_o\Lambda^2\eta,
\quad \eta=\Lambda^2X^{-3/4},\ j\le3.
\]
Its residual and residual-\(z\) bounds are \(CE_o\eta\) and \(CE_o\Lambda\eta\). Both genuine overlaps are paid. Here \(L=\log(X/(4\pi))\), \(\Lambda=1+\log X\).
